name: TOWI Intelligence OS
problem: A user or Evercraft system needs continuous, source-grounded understanding of material changes in the physical world, including what changed, what the evidence establishes, what remains uncertain, which systems are connected, and what deserves deeper investigation.
use_when: what major things are happening in the physical world
what materially changed in the world
investigate this disaster or infrastructure failure
track this developing hazard or physical system
explain what is happening behind this headline
inputs: Systemia Radar/worldstate signals or a bounded research question; optional geography, domain, urgency, decision context and evidence standard.
outputs: Living TOWI dossiers, FLASH/REPORT/WATCH/AFTERMATH classification, evidence ledger, research questions, uncertainty and contradiction state, and editorial packets for Evercraft Journal/Fallen/Clip.
pricing: Public TOWI intelligence surfaces are not currently a paid machine offer.
confirmation: Read-only public intelligence requires no purchase confirmation. Consequential actions, paid work, and publication remain separately gated.
payment_authority: None for the public TOWI desk.
invocation_status: STAGED: TOWI owned runtime, resident desk and read APIs are implemented in Forge Operator. Public deployment must be independently verified before this state is promoted to live.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
